# Declared assumptions (generated by scripts/make_assumptions.py — do not edit by hand)

Every number below is DECLARED: chosen, with a source or a reason, and not fitted. Fitted parameters are listed in the
results files. Costs are annual household costs of a school year as a share of GDP per head (fees, uniforms, transport,
materials, forgone child earnings); only their ratios across levels and sectors and their dated changes are identified,
because the overall scale is absorbed by the fitted cost coefficient.

## Engine defaults used when a country does not override them

| parameter | value | role |
|---|---|---|
| late entry share | 0.15 | share of children starting Grade 1 a year after their planned age |
| repetition, primary | 0.04 | yearly share repeating |
| repetition, secondary | 0.02 | yearly share repeating |

## Philippines (PHL)

**Years:** simulate 1950–2024; train 1971–1995; test 1996–2024.

**Structure:** primary_grades = 6, lower_secondary_grades = 4, upper_secondary_grades = 2, upper_secondary_from = 2017, upper_secondary_note = K-12 (RA 10533, 2013): Grade 11 first offered SY2016/17 (reference year 2017), Grade 12 SY2017/18. Grade-10 completers from reference year 2016 onward go to Grade 11 instead of tertiary., tertiary_years = 4, max_age = 29

> Grades are numbered 1-12 for basic education and T1-T4 for tertiary. 'periods' switch the cycle structure by reference year (UIS convention: the year in which the school year ends).

> K-12 (RA 10533, 2013): Grade 11 first offered SY2016/17 (reference year 2017), Grade 12 SY2017/18. Grade-10 completers from reference year 2016 onward go to Grade 11 instead of tertiary.

**Costs (share of GDP per head):**

| level | public | private |
|---|---|---|
| primary | 0.05 | 0.3 |
| secondary | 0.18 | 0.45 |
| upper_secondary | 0.25 | 0.55 |
| tertiary | 0.45 | 0.8 |

> Annual household cost of a year of schooling (fees, uniforms, transport, materials, plus forgone earnings of the child), as a share of GDP per capita. DECLARED, order-of-magnitude, documented in docs/assumptions.md. Only ratios between sectors/levels and the dated policy changes matter for identification; the overall scale is absorbed by the cost coefficient.

**Dated policy events (cost changes):**

| year | level | sector | change | what |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1989 | secondary | public | -0.07 | Free Public Secondary Education Act (RA 6655, 1988): public secondary tuition abolished from SY1988/89. |
| 1990 | secondary | private | -0.05 | GASTPE / Education Service Contracting subsidies for private secondary places (RA 6728, 1989). |
| 2017 | upper_secondary | private | -0.12 | Senior high school vouchers for public JHS completers enrolling in private SHS (DepEd voucher programme). |
| 2018 | tertiary | public | -0.1 | Free tuition in state and local universities and colleges (RA 10931, 2017; first applied AY2017/18). |
| 2009 (ramp 4y) | primary, secondary | deciles 1, 2, 3 | −0.04 | Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) conditional cash transfers to poor households with children in school (pilot 2008, scaled up 2010-2013; institutionalised RA 11310, 2019). Modelled as a cost reduction for the poorest three deciles. |

**Entry age:** share starting Grade 1 at age 6: 1950: 0.1, 1997: 0.1, 2005: 0.45, 2012: 0.9, 2024: 0.95. Share of children who START Grade 1 at age 6 (rest at 7). WDI official entrance age is 7 to 1997 and 6 from 1998, but actual entry shifted gradually; universal kindergarten (RA 10157, 2012) completed the shift. DECLARED ramp.

**Tertiary public capacity rule:** fiscal (anchor 1985).

## Cambodia (KHM)

**Years:** simulate 1979–2024; train 1995–2010; test 2011–2024.

**Structure:** primary_grades = 6, lower_secondary_grades = 3, upper_secondary_grades = 3, upper_secondary_from = 0, tertiary_years = 4, max_age = 29, late_entry_max_age = 12, late_entry_hazard = 0.15

> 6+3+3 from 1994 (MoEYS; 5+3+3 in 1987-94 is not modelled). Late entry up to age 12 at 15% a year of the never-entered (DECLARED) because overage entry is a defining feature of the Cambodian series.

**Costs (share of GDP per head):**

| level | public | private |
|---|---|---|
| primary | 0.14 | 0.6 |
| secondary | 0.3 | 0.8 |
| upper_secondary | 0.4 | 0.9 |
| tertiary | 0.9 | 1.1 |

> DECLARED. Includes informal fees (about 8.7% of family income per child in 2007, NEP via UNDP), materials and forgone earnings. Public HEIs charge fees in Cambodia.

**Dated policy events (cost changes):**

| year | level | sector | change | what |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2001 | primary | public | -0.06 | Priority Action Program: registration and other start-of-year fees abolished in primary and lower secondary, replaced by school operating grants (SY2000/01). |
| 2001 | secondary | public | -0.06 | Priority Action Program, lower secondary fee abolition. |
| 2004 (ramp 4y) | secondary | deciles 1, 2, 3 | −0.03 | Lower secondary scholarships for poor students (PAP 12 and JFPR, 13,938 recipients in 2003-04 rising to 25,872 in 2007-08). |

**Entry age:** share starting Grade 1 at age 6: 1979: 0.6, 2024: 0.8. DECLARED.

**repetition:** `{"primary": 0.1, "secondary": 0.05}`

> DECLARED, order of MoEYS rates in the 2000s.

**catch_up_entry:** `{"years": [1979, 1990], "max_age": 14, "rate": 0.35}`

> Post-conflict reopening: never-entered children up to 14 enter at 35% a year (DECLARED). Produces the 1980s overage bulge; not fitted.

**tertiary_entry_exam:** `{"default_before_data": 80, "pass_rate": {"2012": 86.48, "2013": 86.77, "2014": 40.67, "2015": 55.87, "2016": 62.18, "2017": 63.84, "2018": 67.07, "2019": 68.62, "2020": 100.0, "2021": 65.65, "2022": 72.33, "2023": 72.89, "2024": 79.0}}`

> Grade 12 national exam (Bac II) first-sitting pass rates, press reports of MoEYS figures (see facts.md). 2014 uses the post-resit 40.67. 2020: exam cancelled, all passed. Before 2012 DECLARED 80.

**wdi_repairs:** `{"NY.GDP.PCAP.KD": {"drop_before": 1994, "why": "WDI constant-dollar GDP per head falls from 845 (1993) to 514 (1994), a series break, not a 39% collapse. Values before 1994 are dropped and the 1994 value is held flat backwards (DECLARED)."}}`

**demography:** `{"pre_data_pop_growth": 0.02, "gini_default": 0.36}`

> WDI has no Gini for Cambodia; 0.36 is DECLARED (order of CSES-based estimates). Simulation starts in 1979, when schools reopened after the Khmer Rouge period: earlier cohorts have no schooling history in the model.

**Tertiary public capacity rule:** unconstrained (anchor 2000).
